turns.question: Of the people who applied to work here between 25 September and 2 October 2026, what share were still in the running at the end of 4 October?
turns.answer: Of the 6 candidates who applied between 25 September and 2 October 2026, 2 were still in the running at the end of 4 October, counting the screen and interview stages as in the running and hired and rejected as out, since the semantic layer has no definition of 'still in the running' (the figures are Candidates in stage, by stage, for 4 October). Late: recruitment.silver is ready only up to 2026-10-03T00:00Z, older than its 36 h deadline.
